title: The span-squares adjunction
summary: We show a universal property of the span $\infty$-category that yields a description of functors defined on this category. For this, we view the span construction as a functor from double $\infty$-categories to $\infty$-categories, and show that this functor admits a right adjoint defined by the double $\infty$-categories of squares. As an application, we obtain a model for the localization of an $\infty$-category in terms of a span $\infty$-category and also give another proof of the model given by the relative nerve.
